posts.name: Chaitanya Gaur
posts.cooked: Missed the first 2 BPTs because I was having some interviews, and was working in an internship and since I have earlier given this subject when there was no BPT so I was not having that much of information about the same. Moreover, I did not recieved any information about the BPT deadlines and necessity on E-Mail untill the deadline of 3rd BPT that submitted , but it was only then when I got to know that its mandatory to submit first 3 BPTs. So can any solution for the same be suggested, since I was taking subjects slow, I have to complete all subjects by this next term so repeating the whole course could not be possible. Even if I would’ve got any e-mail regarding the fact the 3 BPTs are compulsory , I would’ve submitted that, as I was submitting Assignments (both Programming and Graded). So if there is any solution to the same, please let me know

posts.name: Soham Gambhir
posts.cooked: Same with me as well but I missed BPT2 and BPT3. Can anyone please help with this

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
chaitanyagaur5:

I was not having that much of information about the same

It is clearly mentioned in the grading document which the students are expected to go through for their subjects in a term.

Since attempting 3 out of 4 BPTs is a requirement for OPPE, and attempting OPPE is a requirement for End Term, thus indirectly, attempting the BPTs is a requirement for this course.

You can repeat the course as OPPE only in next term if the OPPE is the only thing left for you in this term.
